guard: a manager whose own env carries CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION must not hand that marker to a seat, and PATH must still include the entries connector binaries live in
why: The 0.30.1 defect was inherit-mode launchEnv: envAllow absent copied the manager's ambient
environment (minus COTAL_*) into every seat. A mesh started from inside Claude Code therefore
handed CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION to every spawned seat, which silently disabled transcript
saving. The fix is that launchEnv has no inherit branch: it copies OS_ENV_ALLOW, then
OPERATOR_ENV_KEEP, then the caller-declared extras. Removing the OS allow-list copy restores
the leak AND drops PATH, so both named cells redden together.
SPECIFIER BOUNDARY. env-isolate imports launchEnv from @cotal-ai/connector-core, which
resolves to dist/, so the command builds connector-core first. afterRestore rebuilds so the
tree does not keep a dist compiled from the mutant. The suite itself is source-loaded (tsx
implementations/manager/smoke/env-isolate.smoke.ts) and drives the real pty runtime.
TWO CELLS, ONE MUTATION. Dropping the OS allow-list copy is the closest revert of the strip:
without it, launchEnv copies OPERATOR_ENV_KEEP and extras only, so CLAUDE_CODE_* stays out
(those names are not on the keep list) AND PATH is gone. That is not the 0.30.1 inherit
revert — a full inherit revert would put the marker BACK. The inherit revert is the second
mutation: replacing the allow-list body with the old inherit loop. That one kills the marker
cell and must leave the PATH cell green, proving the two cells discriminate.

mutations.name: strip the OS allow-list copy so PATH (and ~/.local/bin) never reaches the child
mutations.find:
for (const k of OS_ENV_ALLOW) copy(k);
  for (const k of OPERATOR_ENV_KEEP) copy(k);
mutations.note: The load-bearing PATH cell. A manager that cannot resolve connector binaries is a worse defect than the one this change fixes. Named so a revert of the strip cannot ship as a silent PATH loss.

mutations.name: restore inherit-mode launchEnv: copy the manager env minus COTAL_* (the 0.30.1 leak)
mutations.note: The measured defect. Inherit-mode launchEnv is how CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION reached every seat on 0.30.1. PATH still crosses under inherit, so the PATH cell stays green and the two cells discriminate.
